Manx: Meeryn liorish ny Binysee[2], (Inneen Rydings, Ben Arnold Mac Germot as Ben Max Corkel).
English: Pieces by the Binysee, (Miss Rydings, Mrs. Arnold Kermode and Mrs. Max Corkel).[3]
Notes:
[2] Binysee] a word unattested elswehere. Meaning unclear, perhaps from [ben-ynsee] ‘female teacher’?
[3] Note that in this era it was common for a married woman to take her husband’s full name in formal settings.
